FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A01
Pressure gets gauged monthly against the door sticker, while tread gets penny-tested for Lincoln's full head [A01].
Why it matters: group pre-drive-safety; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A01
Tires get monthly gauges and penny tests, while seats demand upright backs, floored heels, and ten-inch chest gaps [A01].
Why it matters: group pre-drive-safety; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F01, sec04-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A02
Rearview mirrors frame the whole rear window, while side mirrors lean-set until the car's edges vanish [A02].
Why it matters: group pre-drive-safety; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F03 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A02
Glass stays legal through cleaning and bare windshields, while bodies stay legal through belts on every occupant [A02].
Why it matters: group pre-drive-safety; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F04, sec04-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A03
Belts restrain through every stop and turn, while bags fire once in a twentieth of a second as backup [A03].
Why it matters: group pre-drive-safety; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F07, sec04-F08 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A04
Forty inches and under means a full restraint, while forty to fifty-seven under age eight means a booster [A04].
Why it matters: group pre-drive-safety; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F11, sec04-F12 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A05
Cargo counts as secure only when nothing moves, while assistance tech counts only when the driver stays engaged [A05].
Why it matters: group pre-drive-safety; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F15, sec04-F16 [A05].
